summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the seven-step procedure in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, a parametrized valid/invalid test, a non-node input test, and a graph-unchanged test. Ran the new tests together with test/test_path.py using the prepared venv's Python: 41 passed. Nothing was committed. Choices to check: the rdf:first presence test uses a value lookup instead of a membership check, because a membership check with a None subject acts as a wildcard. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the prepared venv, so type checking and formatting were verified by reading only; line lengths are within 88 columns.
